<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public ?array $propsAsArray,
        public ?array $propsAsTrue,
        public ?array $propsAsZero,
        public ?array $itemsFalse,
        public ?array $addlArray,
        public ?array $addlNull,
        public ?array $patternEmpty,
        public ?array $patternFalsy,
        public mixed $typeNumber,
        public mixed $typeMixedArray,
        public ?string $requiredBad,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            propsAsArray: $data['propsAsArray'],
            propsAsTrue: $data['propsAsTrue'],
            propsAsZero: $data['propsAsZero'],
            itemsFalse: $data['itemsFalse'],
            addlArray: $data['addlArray'],
            addlNull: $data['addlNull'],
            patternEmpty: $data['patternEmpty'],
            patternFalsy: $data['patternFalsy'],
            typeNumber: $data['typeNumber'],
            typeMixedArray: $data['typeMixedArray'],
            requiredBad: $data['requiredBad'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'propsAsArray' => $this->propsAsArray,
            'propsAsTrue' => $this->propsAsTrue,
            'propsAsZero' => $this->propsAsZero,
            'itemsFalse' => $this->itemsFalse,
            'addlArray' => $this->addlArray,
            'addlNull' => $this->addlNull,
            'patternEmpty' => $this->patternEmpty,
            'patternFalsy' => $this->patternFalsy,
            'typeNumber' => $this->typeNumber,
            'typeMixedArray' => $this->typeMixedArray,
            'requiredBad' => $this->requiredBad,
        ];
    }
}
